origin.description: Plot points and symmetric error bars.
origin.usage: errorbar(x, y, xerr=None, yerr=None, bar_col='red', bar_len=0.01, grid=TRUE, with_=TRUE, add=FALSE)
origin.details: y and the ends of the vertical bars. R time is that series, not a graphics device.
origin.value: Plot points and symmetric error bars.
origin.example: { pdf(file.path(tempdir(),"p.pdf")); y <- c(1,2,3,4); yerr <- rep(0.1, 4); errorbar(1:4, y, yerr=yerr); dev.off(); c(y, y-yerr, y+yerr) }
